purpose: Papers and reports whose machines the replicate-paper skill rebuilds in FEMM. The development set builds and improves the skill; the held-out set measures it with the skill frozen. Each replicated paper has a case file under data/papers/.
selection: Chosen on 2026-10-25 for openly readable full text, geometry complete enough to draw, published numbers usable as frozen targets, FEMM 2D feasibility and spread across machine families. Access and gaps were checked by reading each full text. Extended on 2026-10-26 with unassigned candidates screened the same way, each citation also checked against Crossref or the publisher's page, to cover more families: consequent-pole, coreless, Halbach and spoke-type PM machines, PM-assisted reluctance, flux switching, flux reversal, Vernier, magnetic gearing, eddy-current coupling, wound-field and linear machines, deep-bar cages and actuators, flux-modulated, dual-rotor and inset PM machines, magnetic couplings, a public benchmark IPM and exact analytic field models, among them three subdomain papers checked against FEMM.
screening: geometry says how much of the drawable geometry the source gives (complete, minor gaps, major gaps); target_sources lists where its published numbers come from (analytic, 2d_fea, 3d_fea, measured); software names the FEA tool the paper used, when it says. Entries without them were not assessed.

papers.teaches: An official multi-laboratory benchmark whose cross-section is a DXF file (geometry import), with targets beyond torque: back-EMF harmonics, magnet flux linkage, d/q inductances from separate d and q currents, torque against current phase, and iron loss from stated loss coefficients against measured loss.
papers.known_gaps: The winding is drawn, not stated: Fig. 3(a) of the 2015 article (the authors' FE model) labels every slot. Counterclockwise from the slot centred at 7.5 degrees it reads V-, U+, U+, W-, W-, V+, V+, U-, U-, W+, W+, V-, repeated for the other two poles, so the winding is single-layer, full-pitch, positive sequence counterclockwise. 35 conductors per slot follow from 140 turns per phase if the phase is one series path (star, three-wire per the results page); that is an assumption. The rotor is longer than the stator (67.5 against 60 mm, a 3D effect); one sentence swaps the 2D and 3D cogging values of Table 9; FEA tools not named. The DXF is a complete one-pole sector in metres: 8 mm shaft radius, 27.5 mm rotor, 28 mm bore, 56.1 mm outer radius, a flat magnet pocket with 0.5 mm bridges, and 6 slots with tooth tips and round bottoms.
papers.targets: Measured against FEA back-EMF harmonics at 1500 r/min, magnet flux linkage and cogging torque (tables); measured iron loss at 1000-2000 r/min (table); d/q inductances and torque against current phase (CSV files and plots).
